facts.text: The hotel is surrounded by live oak trees draped in Spanish moss and antebellum architecture.
facts.excerpt: Surrounded by live oak trees draped in Spanish moss and the indigenous allure of antebellum architecture

facts.text: Guests can take one of the hotel's bicycles down Savannah's cobblestone streets to places such as Forsyth Park, the Jepson Center for the Arts and Chippewa Square.
facts.excerpt: Take one of our bicycles for a ride down the cobblestone streets of Savannah and explore historic destinations such as Forsyth Park, Jepson Center for the Arts and Chippewa Square.

facts.text: The hotel is at 256 East Perry Street in downtown Savannah, Georgia.
facts.excerpt: 256 East Perry Street, Savannah, Georgia, USA, 31401

facts.text: The hotel's eclectic design pays homage to its Georgia roots with a curated collection of local artwork.
facts.excerpt: Paying homage to our Georgia roots, we flaunt an eclectic aesthetic infused with a curated collection of local artwork, modern amenities and timeless luxury.

facts.text: The residentially inspired guest rooms have oversized windows, Frette Italian bed linens and notable artwork.
facts.excerpt: residentially inspired guestrooms feature oversized windows, luxurious Frette Italian bed linens, noteable artwork

facts.text: Rooms come with plush bathrobes, soft slippers and marble bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: Plush bathrobes, soft slippers and marble bathrooms will transcend you to blissful luxury

facts.text: In-room spa services such as massages and facials can be arranged.
facts.excerpt: In-room spa services such as soothing massages and revitalizing facials are just a call away

facts.text: The Celebration Suite has full-length mirrors and individual vanities for getting ready in style.
facts.excerpt: Our Celebration Suite offers the perfect place for our guests to get ready in style with full length mirrors and individual vanities.

facts.text: The suites are residential in style, with locally inflected amenities and individual touches.
facts.excerpt: Experience a refreshed take on luxury when you stay in our residential styled suite, decorated with locally-inflected amenities and individual touches.

facts.text: Guests can take in the views from the rooftop pool deck.
facts.excerpt: Feel on top of the world and take in the stunning views from our rooftop pool deck!

facts.text: The pool is open year round.
facts.excerpt: Take a dip in our year round pool after a day exploring downtown Savannah.

facts.text: Private cabanas are available at the rooftop pool.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a private cabana at our rooftop pool.

facts.text: Peregrin, on the hotel's rooftop, pairs panoramic views of Savannah with inventive cocktails and globally inspired small plates.
facts.excerpt: Perched atop Perry Lane Hotel, Peregrin pairs panoramic views of Savannah with inventive cocktails, globally inspired small plates, and an energetic rooftop atmosphere from day to night.

facts.text: The Emporium Kitchen & Wine Market is the hotel's restaurant and wine market, open for breakfast, lunch and dinner.
facts.excerpt: Open for breakfast, lunch and dinner

facts.text: The Wayward is the hotel's on-site bar, serving bespoke cocktails with a mix of glam and punk.
facts.excerpt: Mixing a sprinkle of glam and a dash of punk with a generous helping of extraordinary flare, our on-site bar shakes up bespoke cocktails that are well beyond the norm.

facts.text: An arcade with games from pinball to skee-ball sits next to The Wayward.
facts.excerpt: From pinball to skee-ball we have it all. Located adjacent to Wayward

facts.text: The hotel has a cozy library stocked through local booksellers, and guests can sign out books during their stay.
facts.excerpt: Sit, relax and read in our cozy library, or sign out a book to use while you are our guest. Partnering with local book sellers we offer a wide variety of books.

facts.text: Otium Studio holds regular yoga classes on the hotel's rooftop, which can also be booked for private groups.
facts.excerpt: Our partners at Otium Studio offer regular classes on-site, which can also be booked for private groups.
